content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is the conducting organization responsible for releasing the official notification and managing the recruitment process for various teaching positions across its different campuses.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies have been announced under advertisement number TISS/TEACHING/2026/01 for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts across multiple specialized disciplines and campuses.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The final date for the successful submission of the online application form for TISS Recruitment 2026 is 3 November 2026. Candidates must complete the process before this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for TISS Teaching Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for TISS Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Interested and eligible candidates are required to visit the official website and submit their applications through the designated online application portal.

faq.question: Q5. What are the qualification requirements for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Assistant Professor posts generally require a Master's degree with at least 55% marks, along with clearing the NET/SLET/SET or possessing a Ph.D. degree as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category applicants is ₹2000. Different fee structures are applicable for SC, ST, PwBD, and women candidates as per the official recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in various Academic Pay Levels ranging from Academic Pay Level 10 for Assistant Professors up to Academic Pay Level 14 for Professor positions based on UGC norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TISS Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves the shortlisting of candidates based on their academic scores as per UGC guidelines, followed by a personal interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Which campuses have open vacancies in this notification?
faq.answer: Vacancies are distributed across multiple campuses of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences, including the Tuljapur campus, Hyderabad campus, and Guwahati campus, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF link, the direct apply online link, and the official website link in the Important Links section of this recruitment article for easy access.
